metadata.title: Secure Survey Platform SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing the institutional Secure Survey Platform, providing controlled, ethical, and accountable survey capabilities.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Secure Survey Platform supports institutional surveys used for research, administration, assessment, and engagement, ensuring participant consent, identity handling, response integrity, and data protection.

props.name: platform-role
props.remarks: Secure Survey is a Tier-2 institutional capability with elevated privacy, ethical, and reputational impact.

props.name: implements-pattern
props.remarks: This SSPP is the authoritative implementation and assurance anchor for the Secure Survey composite pattern.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Secure Survey relies on Secure Identity for respondent authentication, eligibility determination, and identity separation where required.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Secure Survey relies on Secure Network for trusted transport, availability, and monitoring.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Secure Survey relies on Secure Email for controlled distribution and notification, using application-based send-only mechanisms.

props.name: survey-trust-model
props.remarks: Survey interactions are explicitly bound to stated purpose, consent terms, and ethical commitments.

props.name: identity-handling
props.remarks: Whether responses are anonymous, pseudonymous, or identifiable must be declared prior to participation and consistently enforced.

props.name: response-integrity
props.remarks: Survey responses must be protected against manipulation, duplicate submission, and unauthorized modification.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Survey platform controls align with the NIST SP 800-53 control families relevant to privacy, identity, access, and auditability.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Survey platforms frequently interact with external respondents and systems, requiring explicit trust boundaries.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Survey capability may be required during institutional disruption or emergencies and must remain available without compromising ethics.

props.name: survey-crypto-restriction
props.remarks: Survey-related encryption keys must be generated and protected through the Key Management Platform, especially for regulated or sensitive survey data.

system-implementation.remarks: The Secure Survey Platform composes multiple survey concerns under unified governance, including consent enforcement, identity handling, survey execution, and post-collection data protection.

roles.title: Survey Owner
roles.remarks: Defines survey purpose, audience, consent terms, and ethical commitments.

roles.title: Survey Ethics Authority
roles.remarks: Ensures surveys comply with ethical standards, consent requirements, and applicable regulations.

roles.title: Survey Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors survey operation, detects abuse, and supports investigation.

control-implementation.remarks: Security and privacy controls are implemented through inherited Secure Identity, Secure Network, and Secure Email SSPPs, combined with survey-specific governance constraints enforced by the Secure Survey patterns.
